article.title: Scheme for renting of motor cabs and motor cycles.
article.html:
75Scheme for renting of motor cabs 2[and motor cycles].

Section 75 · Chapter V · pages 55–56 of the Act

(1) The Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, make a scheme for the purpose of regulating the business of renting of 3[motor cabs or motor cycles to persons desiring to drive either by themselves or through drivers, motor cabs or motor cycles] for their own use and for matters connected therewith.

(2) A scheme made under sub-section (1) may provide for all or any of the following matters, namely:—

(a) licensing of operators under the scheme including grant, renewal and revocation of such licences;

(b) form of application and form of licences and the particulars to be contained therein;

(c) fee to be paid with the application for such licences;

(d) the authorities to which the application shall be made;

(e) condition subject to which such licences may be granted, renewed or revoked;

(f) appeals against orders of refusal to grant or renew such licences and appeals against orders revoking such licences;

(g) conditions subject to which motor cabs 1[and motor cycles] may be rented;

(h) maintenance of records and inspection of such records;

(i) such other matters as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this section.

Page 55

2 Ins. by Act 8 of 2026, s. 2 and Sch. (w.e.f. 15-08-2026).

3 Subs. by Act 54 of 1994, s. 24, for “motor cabs to persons desiring to drive the cabs” (w.e.f. 14-11-1994).

Page 56

1 Ins. by Act 8 of 2026, s. 2 and Sch. (w.e.f. 15-08-2026).
